laptop, commander · fleets home (default), work ·
  app shop → fleet home (the fleet recorded for app shop) · env feat-x
6 commands are hidden here; 'caramelo manual --role all' lists every command
of every role.

COMMANDS
    caramelo app                  Inspect the applications on the machine
      caramelo app list           List the applications, their default branch and their size
    caramelo build                Build a release: one image per service, from a commit
    caramelo commander            The machine you type on: name it and write the files it needs
      caramelo commander init     Name this machine a commander and write the files it needs
    caramelo config               Inspect the effective caramelo.yaml of an app
      caramelo config show        Print the effective configuration, with the source of every field
    caramelo connect              Open local ports for an environment's services and dependencies
    caramelo context              Say where this CLI is running and what a command typed here would act on
    caramelo deploy               Deploy a release to an environment, with gates and a way back
    caramelo down                 Stop an environment's services, keeping its dependencies and data
    caramelo edge                 The machine's public edge: routes, certificates, targets
      caramelo edge ca            Print the machine's internal CA root, to trust it
      caramelo edge counts        Requests, errors and connection failures per hostname and replica
      caramelo edge prune         Remove certificates left behind by an issuer this machine no longer uses
      caramelo edge status        Show the machine's routes, targets and certificates
    caramelo env                  Create, inspect and destroy isolated environments of an app
      caramelo env create         Create an environment: worktree, ports, dependency containers
      caramelo env destroy        Remove an environment: containers, volumes, worktree
      caramelo env exec           Run a command inside an environment, on the machine
      caramelo env export         Print an environment's variables, for eval, .env or JSON
      caramelo env expose         Put an environment's service behind a public hostname
      caramelo env handoff        Give an environment to another peer
      caramelo env list           List the environments of an app
      caramelo env show           Show one environment and what its dependencies are doing
      caramelo env unexpose       Stop serving an environment's public hostnames
      caramelo env url            Print where an environment's services and dependencies answer
    caramelo events               Everything the machine does, whoever started it
    caramelo fleet                Manage the fleets this commander talks to
      caramelo fleet add          Record a fleet by name and the ssh address of its hub
      caramelo fleet default      Make a fleet the one commands talk to when nothing says otherwise
      caramelo fleet list         List the fleets this commander knows
      caramelo fleet remove       Forget a fleet
    caramelo hub                  Commands the machine itself runs: setup, uninstall, status, run
      caramelo hub probe          Ask whether a machine's tunnel port answers from here
      caramelo hub setup          Turn this machine into a Caramelo host (run as root)
    caramelo key                  Manage the SSH keys allowed to use the API
      caramelo key add            Authorize a public key, read from a file or standard input
      caramelo key list           List the authorized keys
      caramelo key remove         Revoke a key by name
    caramelo logs                 Show an environment's service logs, merged and prefixed
    caramelo manual               The manual of this machine: every command that holds here, with examples
    caramelo member               Inspect this machine, and the fleet it is part of
      caramelo member add         Set a box up and join it to this fleet
      caramelo member list        List the machines of the fleet
      caramelo member remove      Remove a machine from the fleet
      caramelo member show        Print the machine record, or one machine of the fleet
      caramelo member token       Print a one-time token a machine can join with
    caramelo peer                 Manage the identities allowed on the machine's network
      caramelo peer add           Admit an identity by its WireGuard public key
      caramelo peer list          List the identities on the machine's network
      caramelo peer remove        Revoke an identity by name
    caramelo promote              End a deploy's watch: stop the old replicas and prune
    caramelo releases             An environment's deploy history, or the app's releases
    caramelo rollback             Put the previous release back
    caramelo run                  Run a command in the app's toolchain inside an environment
    caramelo secrets              The machine's vault: scoped secrets, encrypted at rest
      caramelo secrets export     An environment's resolved secrets, redacted unless --reveal
      caramelo secrets list       Names, scopes and versions — never values
      caramelo secrets rm         Forget secrets at one scope
      caramelo secrets set        Write secrets at one scope
    caramelo status               Show whether caramelod and Docker are up, and how we reached them
    caramelo test                 Run the app's tests inside an environment
    caramelo up                   Start an environment's services and wait for them to be healthy
    caramelo version              Print the caramelo version
    caramelo vpn                  Join a machine's private network
      caramelo vpn config         Print a wg-quick configuration for a third-party WireGuard client
      caramelo vpn down           Leave the machine's network (transparent mode only)
      caramelo vpn install        Install transparent mode: a background service and split DNS (needs root)
      caramelo vpn status         Show the mode, address, last handshake and resolver
      caramelo vpn uninstall      Remove transparent mode's service and DNS entry (needs root)
      caramelo vpn up             Join the machine's network from the commander
